title: Decimal values are valid at exactly the declared precision
summary: Both vector widths accepted magnitude 999.99 at precision five. The four-digit and six-digit controls remained distinct, and values transferred by public setters preserved sign and scale.

change.description: Scalar validation accepts a value whose precision equals the vector precision when the scales match.

notes: Logical decimal precision and scale are unchanged by backing width. Crossing two public setters and readers checks both sign and logical scale.
